## Anime to Real

Turns an anime, cartoon or game character image into a real photo with the same composition: the same pose, framing and scene, with the character as a real person and the background as a real place. A side-by-side of the original and the photo is saved for sharing.

**How to use:** load your image in **Load Image**, set **aspect_ratio** on the Qwen node to the shape of your image (the photo is reframed to it), and run. The sample is a generated character.

**Extra instructions** are added to the end of the prompt. Leave them empty, or steer the result in a few words, for example `a man`, `Western features`, or `East Asian features`.

**What you get** in `output/anime_to_real/`: `real_*.png` and `before_after_*.png`.

**Rerun:** the seed is fixed, so running again with the same image and instructions reuses the last result. Change the `seed` for a new take, also when the result still looks drawn or 3D-rendered.

**Model:** Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo, 1 credit per run. Chibi characters keep their big-head proportions.

**One-time setup.** This workflow uses the Video Factory Qwen-Image 2.1 node; if ComfyUI reports it missing, install it from the Manager. Register at https://h3.oneclickamd.ai/?src=anime-to-real, then save your key to `h3_gateway_api_key.txt` in the ComfyUI user directory (or set `H3_GATEWAY_API_KEY`). On the Windows Desktop app use the file, for example `C:\Users\<you>\AppData\Local\Comfy-Desktop\ComfyUI-Installs\ComfyUI\ComfyUI\user\h3_gateway_api_key.txt`. If the key is missing, the first node fails right away and names the exact file it looked for.

**Your key is not in this workflow**, so the workflow and the images it saves are safe to share.

**From FlowFactory:** more ready-to-run workflows at https://github.com/wangxunx/FlowFactory

---

**中文说明：** 在 Load Image 里换成你的动漫、卡通或游戏角色图，把 Qwen 节点的 aspect_ratio 设成和原图一样的比例（输出会按这个比例重新取景），然后运行。结果保持原图的构图、姿势和场景，角色变成真人，背景变成真实场景。输出在 `output/anime_to_real/`：真人照片 `real_*.png`，外加一张原图和真人照片的左右对比图 `before_after_*.png`。**补充要求**会追加到提示词末尾，可以留空，也可以用几个词调整，例如 `a man`（男性）、`Western features`（欧美面孔）、`East Asian features`（东亚面孔）。seed 固定，图和补充要求不变时再次运行会复用上次的结果；想换一版，或者结果看起来还像画的、像 3D 渲染，就改 seed。模型是 Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo，一次运行 1 credit。Q 版角色会保留大头小身的比例，不推荐。

更多开箱即用的工作流见 FlowFactory：https://github.com/wangxunx/FlowFactory

Transform the image to a realistic photograph. Keep exactly the same composition, framing, camera angle, pose and background layout as the image; only the style changes from a drawing to a real photo. The character becomes a real person with the same hairstyle and hair color, eye color, facial expression and mouth shape, outfit, colors, accessories and anything they hold. Normal human body proportions, a real human face with visible skin pores and natural imperfections, real hair with flyaway strands instead of a wig, little or no makeup, and real fabric with creases and seams. The background becomes a real photographed place with real depth, light and detail. Not cosplay, not a doll, not a 3D render, not a painting, not anime. No text or watermark.
